name: AdventureCraft
description:
*** $200 BUILD CONTEST - runs until 10/31/26 ***

THEME: design our next SPAWN CASTLE + TOWN. Build it on your own creative plot in-game (/plot claim in the Build World). The winning design becomes the REAL server spawn and its builder takes $200 cash. Entry + rules in our Discord.

The Minecraft server where SOMETHING HAPPENS EVERY 30 MINUTES - and your phone is a first-class citizen.

Made for Bedrock: phone, console and PC share ONE world with the Java players, same events, same bosses, same loot table. Add advcraft.gg (default port) and you are in - consoles use the free walkthrough at advcraft.gg/join.

- A TOWN EVENT EVERY 30 MINUTES - sieges, boss fights, star falls, treasure stampedes, podium prizes on every scored one

- 776 CUSTOM ITEMS to chase - earned, rolled, runed, renamed at the God Anvil

- 179 RUNES + 71 SPELLS - soul-powered casting that works great on touch controls

- 25 KEYS hunting you toward the Vault of Fortune - they drop from bosses, events and deep-wild hunts

- THE BUILD WORLD - claim a creative plot the exact size of our spawn city, remake it with full WorldEdit, protected from griefers by design

- PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT - whisper an ambush, hear one coming

- Offline when you won an event? It's in your mailbox. NOTHING IS EVER LOST.

Small server, honest about it - podiums you can actually win, an owner who actually plays, and new players who actually matter.

Bedrock: advcraft.gg, default port | Consoles: advcraft.gg/join | Java friends: advcraft.gg
